{{Youmay|the chemical mixture|the [[Stim|human]]}}
[[File:Stim.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] receives a stim-shot.]]
{{Quote|Ha! Stimulants make a warrior out of even the weakest humans.|[[Canderous Ordo]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''stimulant''', also referred to as a '''stim''' or '''stim drug''',<ref name="DIRP">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Death Is Remotely Possible|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> was a chemical mixture targeted towards the adrenal system, in the form of a one-time use shot, that was injected into the bloodstream in order to provide a boost to the physical capabilities of the user. This enhancement was most commonly used by individuals that were preparing for or already in the midst of a battle. The [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Canderous Ordo]] was adept at preparing stims, which he freely offered to both [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic" /> and the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]]<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> during his travels with them.

The effect was described as "like ten hours of good, deep sleep, and four square meals" until they wore off.<ref name="Republic Commando: Hard Contact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref> Stim drugs could be found in [[medkit]]s.<ref name="DIRP" />

Several hundred years before the [[Third Galactic War]], master [[biochemist]] [[Tellak Skrep]] devised [[the Buzz]], a self-replenishing stimulant that increased the users speed. Only one [[Stimpack/Legends|Stimpak]] was ever made by Skrep, and none were able to reproduce it.

[[Saol-sar]] sold stimulants in the [[Senate Commercial District]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Courscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]],<ref name="Saol-sar">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Senate Commercial District]]|[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]}}</ref> as did [[Valorn Skez]] aboard [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="Skez">{{TORcite|type=location|Coruscant Departures|[[Carrick Station]]}}</ref>

Stimulants, as well as depressants, were used for non-medical, entertainment purposes; [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] such as [[Rimmer's Rest/Legends|Rimmer's Rest]] provided booths for customers to make use of such narcotics undisturbed.<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] used a health stim that he pulled out of a medpac. He had just crash-landed the cruiser [[Valcyn/Legends|Valcyn]] on the surface of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>
